map.逐位朗读一组数字，你在听完后按顺序复述（顺背），或更难地按相反顺序复述（倒背）。: Read out a digit sequence aloud, then repeat it in the same order (forward span) or, harder, in reverse (backward span). The sequence grows longer until you can no longer repeat it correctly; the maximum length obtained is the digit span, a classic measure of working memory and attention.
map.顺背：按原顺序复述数字序列: Forward span: repeat the digit sequence in the original order
map.倒背：按相反顺序复述，难度更高: Backward span: recite in reverse order — harder
map.可设定起始长度与每轮位数: Configurable start length and digits per round
map.纯前端运行，数据不上传: Runs entirely in the browser; data is not uploaded
map.学业与招聘：作为注意力与工作记忆的快速筛查: Academics and recruitment: a quick screen for attention and working memory
map.康复评估：脑损伤后记忆功能随访: Rehabilitation assessment: memory follow-up after brain injury
map.自我训练：每天练几组提升短期记忆: Self-training: practise a few sets a day to improve short-term memory
map.点击开始，记住报出的数字序列: Click start and remember the number sequence read out
map.顺背模式按原序点击或输入，倒背模式按反序: Forward span mode taps or enters in the original order; backward span mode uses the reverse order
map.答对序列加长，答错结束: Longer sequences for correct answers, ends on an error
map.查看顺背与倒背的最大长度: See the maximum length for forward and backward span
map.成人顺背广度通常 7±2 位，倒背约 5~6 位: Adult forward span is usually 7±2 digits, backward span about 5~6 digits
map.倒背更依赖中央执行功能，难度明显更高: Backward span relies more on central executive function and is markedly harder
map.避免边看边记，纯靠记忆更准: Avoid looking while memorizing — pure recall is more accurate
map.疲劳会显著降低成绩，分多次测: Fatigue significantly lowers scores — measure several times
map.数字广度记忆测验 - 在线工具: Digit Span Memory Test - online tool
map.顺背和倒背哪个更难？: Which is harder, forward span or backward span?
map.倒背更难，需要在脑内反转顺序，对中央执行功能要求更高。: Backward span is harder because the order must be reversed in the head, which places higher demands on central executive function.
map.倒背成绩差代表什么？: What does a poor backward span score mean?
map.可能反映工作记忆的执行控制较弱，但不能单凭一次结果下结论。: It may reflect weaker executive control of working memory, but a single result should not support a conclusion.
